title: Investigating Information Inconsistency in Multilingual Open-domain Question Answering
reasoning: The paper focuses on factual inconsistencies and cultural/social biases in multilingual open-domain question answering datasets like TyDi QA and XOR-TyDi QA. While it explores cultural differences and social landscapes, it does not have a component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral frameworks.
